servers.name: codebase-memory-mcp
servers.install: Run the install script from the repository (curl … install.sh | bash on macOS and Linux, install.ps1 on Windows) and restart your agent; or in Claude Code run claude plugin marketplace add DeusData/codebase-memory-mcp, then claude plugin install codebase-memory@codebase-memory
servers.requires: No account or API key; a macOS, Linux or Windows machine. The Claude Code plugin needs Node for npx
servers.clients: Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and the other clients its installer detects (45 integrations in the README)
servers.does: Indexes a repository into a local code graph so the agent can search symbols, trace callers and callees, and run read-only graph queries instead of reading files one by one

servers.name: ArtCraft MCP (VectorCraft and CADCraft)
servers.transport: stdio (local); headless, or bridged to the running desktop app
servers.install: Download the vectorcraft-cli or cadcraft-cli release for your system (on macOS a separate cli zip; on Linux it ships with the app), then add it to your agent, for example claude mcp add vectorcraft -- vectorcraft-cli mcp --headless, or claude mcp add cadcraft -- cadcraft-cli mcp
servers.requires: No account or API key; macOS, Windows, Linux or FreeBSD. The desktop app only for the live mode
servers.clients: Claude Code, Claude Desktop and other MCP clients that start stdio servers
servers.does: Lets an agent draw, inspect, render and export vector artwork in VectorCraft, or 2D CAD drawings in CADCraft, through the apps' own commands

servers.name: Ghidra MCP (pyghidra-mcp and GhidraMCP)
servers.transport: stdio or streamable HTTP (local); headless, or with the Ghidra GUI
servers.install: Install Ghidra 12.1.4 and Java 21 and set GHIDRA_INSTALL_DIR, then run uvx pyghidra-mcp --project-path <dir> <binary>, or uvx --from "ghidra-mcp[headless] @ git+https://github.com/LaurieWired/GhidraMCP" ghidra-mcp --headless --binary <binary> (or the GhidraMCP extension in the Ghidra GUI)
servers.requires: Ghidra 12.1.4, Java 21, uv or Python 3.10 to 3.13. No account or API key. On macOS, Ghidra's decompiler must be built once with gradlew buildNatives
servers.clients: Claude Code, Claude Desktop, VS Code, Cursor and other MCP clients
servers.does: Lets an agent reverse engineer binaries with Ghidra: list functions and strings, decompile, disassemble, read bytes, follow cross-references, and rename or retype what it learns
